verdict.rationale: mise supports parallel task dependency graphs (mise-docs-11, mise-docs-76) and can run tasks across a monorepo/toolchain, and tasks can be grouped and run together, which enables some bulk operations across a project's tasks/tools. However there's no evidence of bulk operations across many discrete items (e.g., batch-updating many packages/tools/versions at once, applying an action across a large item set) framed for AI-native/agentic bulk workflows. missing for 10: explicit bulk-update/batch-processing commands across many tools or items, evidence of AI-native agent orchestrating bulk operations via MCP beyond single task runs, and independent confirmation of parallel bulk execution at scale.
